questions.question: Hey Demo! Welcome, welcome. I always like to start these conversations naturally rather than jumping straight into questions. So tell me — in your own words, who are you and what brings you here today?
questions.feedback: Warm and authentic introduction covering relevant background and passion for engineering.

answers.answer: Computer Science and data science student at MIT Academy of veterinary community. I'm passionate about software development about solving an AI. I've built projects using node.js express.js and mongodb. I'm here to Showcase my skills learn from this opportunity and work as a developer.

questions.question: What is the N+1 query problem and how does it specifically manifest when using MongoDB with Mongoose? How do you detect it and fix it using aggregation pipelines or populate?
questions.feedback: Solid explanation of the N+1 query pattern in Document databases and effective mitigation via aggregation pipelines.

answers.answer: The N+1 query issue occurs when querying parent records followed by individual queries for each associated child document. In Mongoose, we resolve this using aggregation $lookup pipelines with proper indexing.

questions.question: Design a secure authentication system for a React SPA backed by a Node.js REST API. Cover JWT access tokens, refresh token rotation, HttpOnly cookies, and how to prevent CSRF and XSS attacks end-to-end.
questions.feedback: Good security fundamentals on refresh token rotation and HttpOnly cookie protection.

answers.answer: We store access tokens in memory to prevent XSS and long-lived refresh tokens in HttpOnly SameSite=Strict cookies. Automatic rotation invalidates reused tokens upon refresh.

questions.question: Explain JavaScript's event loop, call stack, microtask queue, and macrotask queue. What is the execution order when you have Promise.resolve().then(), setTimeout(fn, 0), and process.nextTick() all scheduled at the same time?
questions.feedback: Good grasp of microtasks vs macrotask execution order in V8 runtime.

answers.answer: process.nextTick takes priority before microtask queue resolution, followed by Promise then-callbacks, and macrotasks like setTimeout(0) execute in subsequent turns of the event loop.

questions.question: Implement a debounce(fn, wait, options) function in JavaScript that supports both leading-edge and trailing-edge execution, and includes a .cancel() method to abort any pending invocation.
questions.feedback: Outstanding implementation of debounce with cancellation and leading/trailing execution control.

answers.answer: Closure wraps timerId and tracks leading invocation state, resetting on delay completion with a dedicated cancel() method.

questions.question: Explain the Node.js event loop phases in detail. What is the exact execution priority between process.nextTick, Promise microtasks, and setImmediate?
questions.expectedAnswer: Phases: timers, pending callbacks, idle/prepare, poll, check (setImmediate), close. process.nextTick executes immediately after the current operation before microtask queue and event loop ticks.
